```{r message = FALSE, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

### Load models

load(file = "../models/m-all.Rdata")
load(file = "../models/m-bidens.Rdata")
load(file = "../models/m-buddleja.Rdata")
load(file = "../models/m-cortaderia.Rdata")
load(file = "../models/m-oenothera.Rdata")
load(file = "../models/m-paspalum.Rdata")
load(file = "../models/m-reynoutria.Rdata")
load(file = "../models/m-robinia.Rdata")

### Model diagnostics

plot(m1) # All
plot(m2) # Robinia
plot(m3) # Bidens
plot(m4) # Cortaderia
plot(m5) # Paspalum
plot(m6) # Buddleja
plot(m7) # Oenothera
plot(m8) # Reynoutria

### Model summary

summary(m1) # All
summary(m2) # Robinia
summary(m3) # Bidens
summary(m4) # Cortaderia
summary(m5) # Paspalum
summary(m6) # Buddleja
summary(m7) # Oenothera
summary(m8) # Reynoutria

### Phylo signal http://www.mpcm-evolution.com/practice/online-practical-material-chapter-11/chapter-11-1-simple-model-mcmcglmm

#### All

lambda <- m1$VCV[,"animal"]/(m1$VCV[,"animal"] + m1$VCV[,"units"])
data.frame(
  lambda = mean(lambda) %>% round(2),
  min = coda::HPDinterval(lambda)[, 1] %>% round(2),
  max = coda::HPDinterval(lambda)[, 2] %>% round(2))
```
